# Diagnostics

Holotype reports every fallback, approximation and failure as a diagnostic with a stable code.
Search this page for the code shown in the report, the plugin or the CLI output.
Each code links to its own page with what happened, what to do and where the behaviour is specified.

279 codes in 14 areas. Severities:

- **info**: a lossless choice worth knowing about. Usually nothing to do.
- **warning**: a visible approximation. The result differs from the code in a way you can see.
- **error**: a component or variant was not produced, or was produced incorrectly.

The source of truth is the [diagnostics catalog](../../internal/plan/12-quality.md#diagnostics) in the design notes.

## Storybook (`SB_`)

| Code | Severity | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="SB_INDEX_UNREACHABLE"></a>[`SB_INDEX_UNREACHABLE`](SB_INDEX_UNREACHABLE.md) | error | `index.json`/`stories.json` could not be loaded; aborts the run (`data.fatal: true`, exit 3). | Check the URL and that Storybook is running. For a static build, run `storybook build` and point Holotype at `storybook-static/`. |
| <a id="SB_IFRAME_UNREACHABLE"></a>[`SB_IFRAME_UNREACHABLE`](SB_IFRAME_UNREACHABLE.md) | error | `iframe.html` did not return 200. | Make sure your host serves `iframe.html` next to `index.json` (check base path and rewrite rules). |
| <a id="SB_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED"></a>[`SB_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED`](SB_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.md) | error | Storybook older than 8 (D-11). | Upgrade to Storybook 10 (8 and 9 work best-effort). |
| <a id="SB_VERSION_UNTESTED"></a>[`SB_VERSION_UNTESTED`](SB_VERSION_UNTESTED.md) | warning | Newer Storybook major than the newest adapter; the newest adapter was used. | Update Holotype. If the output looks wrong, use **Copy diagnostic** and send it with the run's `report.json` to the support contact in Settings. |
| <a id="SB_MANIFEST_UNPARSEABLE"></a>[`SB_MANIFEST_UNPARSEABLE`](SB_MANIFEST_UNPARSEABLE.md) | info | The components manifest has an unknown shape; in-page docgen was used instead. | Nothing to do. Update Holotype if props look incomplete. |
| <a id="SB_DOCGEN_DEGRADED"></a>[`SB_DOCGEN_DEGRADED`](SB_DOCGEN_DEGRADED.md) | warning | Storybook 11 dev server without its docgen service; argTypes are reduced. | Capture from a static build (`storybook build`), or add `@storybook/addon-mcp`. |
| <a id="SB_REF_AUTH_REQUIRED"></a>[`SB_REF_AUTH_REQUIRED`](SB_REF_AUTH_REQUIRED.md) | warning | A composed Storybook ref needs a login; its stories were skipped. | Run `holotype login --storybook <ref URL>`, then re-run. |
| <a id="SB_AUTH_FAILED"></a>[`SB_AUTH_FAILED`](SB_AUTH_FAILED.md) | error | 401/403 on `index.json`. | Set `HOLOTYPE_SB_TOKEN` (or `HOLOTYPE_SB_HEADERS`) or run `holotype login --storybook <url>`. |
| <a id="SB_AUTH_REDIRECT"></a>[`SB_AUTH_REDIRECT`](SB_AUTH_REDIRECT.md) | error | `index.json` redirected to a login page. | Run `holotype login --storybook <url>` and sign in once in the window that opens. |
| <a id="SB_STORY_LOAD_FAILED"></a>[`SB_STORY_LOAD_FAILED`](SB_STORY_LOAD_FAILED.md) | error | `loadStory` threw (CSF import error); the story was skipped. | Open the story in Storybook and fix the import error shown in the report. |
| <a id="SB_METADATA_TIMEOUT"></a>[`SB_METADATA_TIMEOUT`](SB_METADATA_TIMEOUT.md) | error | A metadata batch hung for 30 s; retried on a fresh page. | Look for a story file that hangs on import (top-level `await`, network call) and fix it, or leave it out with `exclude`. |
| <a id="SB_PREVIEW_INIT_TIMEOUT"></a>[`SB_PREVIEW_INIT_TIMEOUT`](SB_PREVIEW_INIT_TIMEOUT.md) | error | The preview never became ready. | Open `iframe.html` in a browser and fix the errors in its console, then re-run. |
| <a id="SB_RENDER_TIMEOUT"></a>[`SB_RENDER_TIMEOUT`](SB_RENDER_TIMEOUT.md) | error | No `storyRendered`/`storyFinished` within `T.render` (15 s); retried twice, then the variant fails. | Check loaders and play functions that wait on network or timers, and mock them for capture. |
| <a id="SB_STORY_UNRENDERABLE"></a>[`SB_STORY_UNRENDERABLE`](SB_STORY_UNRENDERABLE.md) | error | The story kept failing after three reloads; the component fails. | Fix the story in Storybook, or tag it `!figma` to leave it out. |
| <a id="SB_STORY_ERROR"></a>[`SB_STORY_ERROR`](SB_STORY_ERROR.md) | error | Storybook reported `storyErrored`/`storyThrewException`; the variant fails (retried twice). | Open the story with the args in the report and fix the error message shown. |
| <a id="SB_PLAY_ERROR"></a>[`SB_PLAY_ERROR`](SB_PLAY_ERROR.md) | error | The play function threw; the variant fails. | Fix the play function (the report shows its error and stack). |
| <a id="SB_STORY_MISSING"></a>[`SB_STORY_MISSING`](SB_STORY_MISSING.md) | error | The story id is not in the index (renamed or removed). | Re-run after rebuilding Storybook; update ids pinned in config. |
| <a id="SB_CONSOLE_ERROR"></a>[`SB_CONSOLE_ERROR`](SB_CONSOLE_ERROR.md) | info | Console errors were logged during the render (the browser's own `/favicon.ico` request excluded). | Nothing to do unless the render looks blank; then read the logged errors. |
| <a id="SB_URL_ARG_UNENCODABLE"></a>[`SB_URL_ARG_UNENCODABLE`](SB_URL_ARG_UNENCODABLE.md) | warning | In URL-fallback mode an arg value cannot be encoded in the URL; the variant was skipped. | Drop `--no-channel` (or use a build where the preview API works), or limit values to letters, digits, space, `_` and `-`. |
| <a id="SB_ARG_UNKNOWN"></a>[`SB_ARG_UNKNOWN`](SB_ARG_UNKNOWN.md) | warning | A configured arg has no argType; it was dropped. | Fix the arg name in config, or add an argType for it. |
| <a id="SB_DECORATOR_PAINTS"></a>[`SB_DECORATOR_PAINTS`](SB_DECORATOR_PAINTS.md) | info | A decorator paints a background; it is used as the canvas background, not part of the component. | Nothing to do. Remove the background from the decorator if you want a transparent canvas. |
| <a id="SB_COMPONENT_MULTI_TITLE"></a>[`SB_COMPONENT_MULTI_TITLE`](SB_COMPONENT_MULTI_TITLE.md) | info | One component appears under several titles; they were not merged. | To merge them into one component set, set `component:` in config. |
| <a id="SB_HOST_NOT_ALLOWED"></a>[`SB_HOST_NOT_ALLOWED`](SB_HOST_NOT_ALLOWED.md) | error | The Storybook dev server rejected our host (its `allowedHosts` check). | Add the host to `core.allowedHosts` in `.storybook/main`. |
| <a id="SB_HMR_DURING_CAPTURE"></a>[`SB_HMR_DURING_CAPTURE`](SB_HMR_DURING_CAPTURE.md) | warning | The dev server reloaded mid-run; the component was retried once. | Avoid saving files during a run, or capture from a static build. |
| <a id="SB_ROOT_NOT_FOUND"></a>[`SB_ROOT_NOT_FOUND`](SB_ROOT_NOT_FOUND.md) | error | The capture root selector matched nothing. | Fix `parameters.holotype.rootSelector` (or remove it to use `#storybook-root`). |
| <a id="SB_PORTAL_AMBIGUOUS"></a>[`SB_PORTAL_AMBIGUOUS`](SB_PORTAL_AMBIGUOUS.md) | warning | Several candidate portal roots; their union was used. | Set `parameters.holotype.portal.selector` to the right overlay. |
| <a id="SB_NOT_A_STORYBOOK"></a>[`SB_NOT_A_STORYBOOK`](SB_NOT_A_STORYBOOK.md) | error | The target has no `index.json` plus `iframe.html` with a Storybook preview. | Point Holotype at the root URL of a Storybook. |

## Planner, config and mapper structure (`PLAN_`)

| Code | Severity | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="PLAN_CONFIG_INVALID"></a>[`PLAN_CONFIG_INVALID`](PLAN_CONFIG_INVALID.md) | error | A config value fails the schema; the run stops (exit 2). | Fix the value at the JSON pointer printed with the error. |
| <a id="PLAN_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEY"></a>[`PLAN_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEY`](PLAN_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEY.md) | warning | Unknown key in `holotype.config.ts`; ignored. | Check the spelling against the "did you mean…" hint. |
| <a id="PLAN_PARAM_UNKNOWN_KEY"></a>[`PLAN_PARAM_UNKNOWN_KEY`](PLAN_PARAM_UNKNOWN_KEY.md) | warning | Unknown key in `parameters.holotype`; ignored. | Check the spelling; the addon's types catch this while you type. |
| <a id="PLAN_ENUM_UNRESOLVED"></a>[`PLAN_ENUM_UNRESOLVED`](PLAN_ENUM_UNRESOLVED.md) | warning | Docgen gave a type alias that cannot be enumerated; the arg was not made an axis. | Add `options` to the argType. |
| <a id="PLAN_ARG_NOT_ENUMERABLE"></a>[`PLAN_ARG_NOT_ENUMERABLE`](PLAN_ARG_NOT_ENUMERABLE.md) | info | A text, object or node arg was fixed at its `initialArgs` value. | Nothing to do. To make it an axis, list its values in `args.<name>.values`. |
| <a id="PLAN_ARG_NO_VISUAL_EFFECT"></a>[`PLAN_ARG_NO_VISUAL_EFFECT`](PLAN_ARG_NO_VISUAL_EFFECT.md) | info | The arg never changes the render (e.g. `onClick`, `aria-*`); ignored. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="PLAN_BOOLEAN_PROMOTED_TO_VARIANT"></a>[`PLAN_BOOLEAN_PROMOTED_TO_VARIANT`](PLAN_BOOLEAN_PROMOTED_TO_VARIANT.md) | info | A boolean does more than show/hide a layer, so it became a variant axis. | Nothing to do. To get a Figma boolean, make the prop only toggle visibility. |
| <a id="PLAN_CLASSIFICATION_REJECTED"></a>[`PLAN_CLASSIFICATION_REJECTED`](PLAN_CLASSIFICATION_REJECTED.md) | warning | A classification you forced in config failed render-and-diff; VARIANT was used. | Remove the forced classification, or change the component so the prop matches it. |
| <a id="PLAN_TEXT_PARTIAL"></a>[`PLAN_TEXT_PARTIAL`](PLAN_TEXT_PARTIAL.md) | warning | The arg is part of a larger text (e.g. `"{count} items"`); the property holds the whole text. | Render the arg in its own element if designers should edit it alone. |
| <a id="PLAN_TEXT_MULTI_NODE"></a>[`PLAN_TEXT_MULTI_NODE`](PLAN_TEXT_MULTI_NODE.md) | warning | The arg text appears in several layers; only the first is bound. | Nothing to do, or drop the duplicate (e.g. a tooltip echoing the label). |
| <a id="PLAN_TEXT_UNBOUND"></a>[`PLAN_TEXT_UNBOUND`](PLAN_TEXT_UNBOUND.md) | info | A string arg could not be bound to a text layer; it was fixed. | Make sure the arg renders as plain text in one element. |
| <a id="PLAN_SWAP_OPTION_UNRESOLVED"></a>[`PLAN_SWAP_OPTION_UNRESOLVED`](PLAN_SWAP_OPTION_UNRESOLVED.md) | warning | An instance-swap option has no matching component. | Import that component too, or remove the option. |
| <a id="PLAN_SLOT_UNVERIFIED"></a>[`PLAN_SLOT_UNVERIFIED`](PLAN_SLOT_UNVERIFIED.md) | info | A slot was inferred without an empty-content probe. | Nothing to do. Allow empty children in the story to verify it. |
| <a id="PLAN_VALUES_MERGED"></a>[`PLAN_VALUES_MERGED`](PLAN_VALUES_MERGED.md) | info | Two values of an axis render the same; merged under the first label. | Nothing to do, or make the values look different. |
| <a id="PLAN_PROPERTY_INCONSISTENT"></a>[`PLAN_PROPERTY_INCONSISTENT`](PLAN_PROPERTY_INCONSISTENT.md) | warning | A property behaved differently on a non-default variant; demoted to VARIANT. | Check the variant named in the report; the prop changes more than expected there. |
| <a id="PLAN_UNVERIFIED_CLASSIFICATION"></a>[`PLAN_UNVERIFIED_CLASSIFICATION`](PLAN_UNVERIFIED_CLASSIFICATION.md) | info | `classification: 'fast'` used priors without probes. | Use the default classification for the final sync. |
| <a id="PLAN_SPARSE_SET"></a>[`PLAN_SPARSE_SET`](PLAN_SPARSE_SET.md) | warning | The set has missing combinations; switching to one snaps to the nearest. | Raise `budget.max`, or accept the sparse set. |
| <a id="PLAN_AXIS_DROPPED_BUDGET"></a>[`PLAN_AXIS_DROPPED_BUDGET`](PLAN_AXIS_DROPPED_BUDGET.md) | warning | An axis was pinned to its default to stay within budget. | Use "include" in the report, or raise `budget.max`. |
| <a id="PLAN_MATRIX_NONE"></a>[`PLAN_MATRIX_NONE`](PLAN_MATRIX_NONE.md) | info | `matrix: 'none'`: the component was built as one component from its default variant; its variant args and states were pinned (`data.pinned`). | Nothing to do. To get variants, set `matrix` back to `auto` (or drop `--variants none`). |
| <a id="PLAN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED"></a>[`PLAN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED`](PLAN_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.md) | error | The matrix is over `budget.hardLimit`; the component was refused. | Reduce axes or values, or pass `--force`. |
| <a id="PLAN_PROBE_BUDGET"></a>[`PLAN_PROBE_BUDGET`](PLAN_PROBE_BUDGET.md) | warning | The probe budget ran out; the remaining args were classified by priors. | Raise `budget.maxProbes`, or classify those args in config. |
| <a id="PLAN_CONDITIONAL_DUPLICATE"></a>[`PLAN_CONDITIONAL_DUPLICATE`](PLAN_CONDITIONAL_DUPLICATE.md) | info | An argType `if` collapses combinations; the duplicates are built as clones. | Nothing to do, or set `conditional: 'sparse'` to omit them. |
| <a id="PLAN_DUPLICATE_VARIANT"></a>[`PLAN_DUPLICATE_VARIANT`](PLAN_DUPLICATE_VARIANT.md) | info | Two combinations produced the same render; reported by render-hash dedup. | Nothing to do, or remove the redundant arg values. |
| <a id="PLAN_AXIS_NO_EFFECT"></a>[`PLAN_AXIS_NO_EFFECT`](PLAN_AXIS_NO_EFFECT.md) | warning | Every value of an axis renders the same; the axis was removed. | Check the arg is wired to the component; remove it from config if unused. |
| <a id="PLAN_STATE_NO_EFFECT"></a>[`PLAN_STATE_NO_EFFECT`](PLAN_STATE_NO_EFFECT.md) | info | A pseudo-state looks the same as default; dropped. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="PLAN_THEME_AS_AXIS"></a>[`PLAN_THEME_AS_AXIS`](PLAN_THEME_AS_AXIS.md) | warning | Theme differences are not explained by tokens, so themes became a `Theme` variant axis. | Move the listed hard-coded values into tokens to get Figma modes instead. |
| <a id="PLAN_VIEWPORT_STRUCTURE_CHANGE"></a>[`PLAN_VIEWPORT_STRUCTURE_CHANGE`](PLAN_VIEWPORT_STRUCTURE_CHANGE.md) | info | The layout changes structure across viewports. | Consider `viewports.as: 'components'`. |
| <a id="PLAN_STORY_SPLIT"></a>[`PLAN_STORY_SPLIT`](PLAN_STORY_SPLIT.md) | info | Too many unexplained stories; split into separate components. | Nothing to do, or add args so the stories become variants. |
| <a id="PLAN_COMPAT_SPLIT"></a>[`PLAN_COMPAT_SPLIT`](PLAN_COMPAT_SPLIT.md) | info | A story.to.design setting was mapped to a split into components. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="PLAN_COMPAT_UNSUPPORTED"></a>[`PLAN_COMPAT_UNSUPPORTED`](PLAN_COMPAT_UNSUPPORTED.md) | warning | A story.to.design setting has no equivalent (e.g. `:tap`). | Replace it with an arg, as the hint says. |
| <a id="PLAN_CHROMATIC_DISABLED_HINT"></a>[`PLAN_CHROMATIC_DISABLED_HINT`](PLAN_CHROMATIC_DISABLED_HINT.md) | info | Chromatic `disableSnapshot` seen; the story is still captured. | Tag the story `!figma` if you want it left out. |
| <a id="PLAN_SUGGEST_MERGE_AXES"></a>[`PLAN_SUGGEST_MERGE_AXES`](PLAN_SUGGEST_MERGE_AXES.md) | info | Exclusive booleans could become one axis. | Accept the suggestion in config (`args.<name>.values`). |
| <a id="PLAN_ICON_SPLIT"></a>[`PLAN_ICON_SPLIT`](PLAN_ICON_SPLIT.md) | info | An icon enum was split into one component per value. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="PLAN_FEATURE_DOWNGRADED"></a>[`PLAN_FEATURE_DOWNGRADED`](PLAN_FEATURE_DOWNGRADED.md) | warning | The plugin lacks an IR feature, so the output was downgraded (e.g. slots → frames). | Update the Figma plugin. |
| <a id="PLAN_COMPONENT_TOO_LARGE"></a>[`PLAN_COMPONENT_TOO_LARGE`](PLAN_COMPONENT_TOO_LARGE.md) | warning (error over 8 MB) | A `SceneComponent` file is over 2 MB; variants were reduced. | Lower the variant budget or split the component. |
| <a id="PLAN_BUNDLE_LARGE"></a>[`PLAN_BUNDLE_LARGE`](PLAN_BUNDLE_LARGE.md) | warning | The bundle is over 100 MB (rejected above 200 MB with `APPLY_BUNDLE_REJECTED`). | Sync fewer components per run, or split by `include`. |
| <a id="PLAN_INVARIANT_VIOLATION"></a>[`PLAN_INVARIANT_VIOLATION`](PLAN_INVARIANT_VIOLATION.md) | error | The mapper produced invalid output (a Holotype bug); the component was skipped. | Use **Copy diagnostic** and send it with `report.json` to the support contact in Settings; the other components are unaffected. |
| <a id="PLAN_MAPPER_FAILED"></a>[`PLAN_MAPPER_FAILED`](PLAN_MAPPER_FAILED.md) | error | The mapper threw (a Holotype bug); the component failed. | Use **Copy diagnostic** (it includes the stack) and send it to the support contact in Settings; the other components are unaffected. |
| <a id="PLAN_ALIGNMENT_ANCHOR_CONFLICT"></a>[`PLAN_ALIGNMENT_ANCHOR_CONFLICT`](PLAN_ALIGNMENT_ANCHOR_CONFLICT.md) | warning | Two layers share an anchor (e.g. a `data-testid`) across variants. | Make test ids unique within the component. |
| <a id="PLAN_ALIGNMENT_DIVERGENT"></a>[`PLAN_ALIGNMENT_DIVERGENT`](PLAN_ALIGNMENT_DIVERGENT.md) | warning | Variants are structurally unrelated; kept as separate subtrees. | Consider splitting them into separate components. |
| <a id="PLAN_ALIGNMENT_ORDER_CONFLICT"></a>[`PLAN_ALIGNMENT_ORDER_CONFLICT`](PLAN_ALIGNMENT_ORDER_CONFLICT.md) | warning | Variants disagree on layer order; that variant's parent fell back to absolute. | Nothing to do, or avoid z-index changes between states. |
| <a id="PLAN_PROPERTY_UNBOUND"></a>[`PLAN_PROPERTY_UNBOUND`](PLAN_PROPERTY_UNBOUND.md) | warning | A planned property bound to no layer; it was dropped. | Check the arg renders something; see the report for the property. |
| <a id="PLAN_INSTANCE_PROPS_UNMAPPED"></a>[`PLAN_INSTANCE_PROPS_UNMAPPED`](PLAN_INSTANCE_PROPS_UNMAPPED.md) | info | A nested component's props don't map to its properties; kept as a frame. | Expose those props as args on the nested component. |
| <a id="PLAN_INSTANCE_MISMATCH"></a>[`PLAN_INSTANCE_MISMATCH`](PLAN_INSTANCE_MISMATCH.md) | info | A nested component's capture differs from its own story; kept as a frame. | Nothing to do; it is retried once the nested component is imported. |

## Capture (`CAP_`)

| Code | Severity | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="CAP_PAGE_CRASHED"></a>[`CAP_PAGE_CRASHED`](CAP_PAGE_CRASHED.md) | warning | The browser page crashed; the variant was retried once. | Nothing to do if it passed on retry; otherwise look for memory-heavy stories. |
| <a id="CAP_SR_ONLY_SKIPPED"></a>[`CAP_SR_ONLY_SKIPPED`](CAP_SR_ONLY_SKIPPED.md) | info | Screen-reader-only content was skipped (counted only). | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="CAP_CLIPPED_CULLED"></a>[`CAP_CLIPPED_CULLED`](CAP_CLIPPED_CULLED.md) | info | A node fully hidden by an ancestor's clip was removed. | Nothing to do. Planner-bound layers are always kept. |
| <a id="CAP_IFRAME_RASTERIZED"></a>[`CAP_IFRAME_RASTERIZED`](CAP_IFRAME_RASTERIZED.md) | warning | An iframe (e.g. cross-origin) could not be walked and was captured as an image. | Render the content without an iframe in the story if you need editable layers. |
| <a id="CAP_NON_AFFINE_RASTERIZED"></a>[`CAP_NON_AFFINE_RASTERIZED`](CAP_NON_AFFINE_RASTERIZED.md) | warning | A 3D or perspective transform subtree was captured as an image. | Nothing to do, or provide a flat story state for Figma. |
| <a id="CAP_ANIMATED_GIF"></a>[`CAP_ANIMATED_GIF`](CAP_ANIMATED_GIF.md) | info | An animated GIF keeps only its first frame. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="CAP_ANIMATION_FROZEN"></a>[`CAP_ANIMATION_FROZEN`](CAP_ANIMATION_FROZEN.md) | info | An infinite animation was frozen at t=0. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="CAP_IMAGE_DOWNSCALED"></a>[`CAP_IMAGE_DOWNSCALED`](CAP_IMAGE_DOWNSCALED.md) | info | An image over 4096 px was downscaled (Figma's limit). | Nothing to do, or ship a smaller source image. |
| <a id="CAP_IMAGE_TRANSCODED"></a>[`CAP_IMAGE_TRANSCODED`](CAP_IMAGE_TRANSCODED.md) | info | A WebP/AVIF/HEIC/ICO/BMP image was re-encoded as PNG or JPEG. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="CAP_CANVAS_RASTERIZED"></a>[`CAP_CANVAS_RASTERIZED`](CAP_CANVAS_RASTERIZED.md) | info | A `<canvas>` was captured as an image. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="CAP_PSEUDO_UNMEASURED"></a>[`CAP_PSEUDO_UNMEASURED`](CAP_PSEUDO_UNMEASURED.md) | warning | A `::before`/`::after` could not be measured and was left out. | Use a real element instead of the pseudo-element if it matters in Figma. |
| <a id="CAP_PSEUDO_MATERIALIZED"></a>[`CAP_PSEUDO_MATERIALIZED`](CAP_PSEUDO_MATERIALIZED.md) | info | A pseudo-element was measured through the materialization fallback. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="CAP_FOCUS_VISIBLE_UNREACHED"></a>[`CAP_FOCUS_VISIBLE_UNREACHED`](CAP_FOCUS_VISIBLE_UNREACHED.md) | warning | Tab navigation never reached the target; focus was set directly, so `:focus-visible` may not show. | Make the element keyboard-focusable, or set `stateTarget`. |
| <a id="CAP_STATE_LOST"></a>[`CAP_STATE_LOST`](CAP_STATE_LOST.md) | warning | A forced hover/focus state was lost because the framework re-rendered. | Check that variant in Figma; avoid re-mounting on hover in the story. |
| <a id="CAP_STATE_PORTAL_IGNORED"></a>[`CAP_STATE_PORTAL_IGNORED`](CAP_STATE_PORTAL_IGNORED.md) | info | A state opened a portal (e.g. a tooltip) that was left out. | Set `states.includePortals: true` to include it. |
| <a id="CAP_PROBE_REMOUNTED"></a>[`CAP_PROBE_REMOUNTED`](CAP_PROBE_REMOUNTED.md) | info | The component re-mounted during the layout probe; nodes matched by path. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="CAP_SERIALIZE_FAILED"></a>[`CAP_SERIALIZE_FAILED`](CAP_SERIALIZE_FAILED.md) | error | The serializer threw twice; the variant failed. | Use **Copy diagnostic** (it includes the stack) and send it to the support contact in Settings. |
| <a id="CAP_NONFINITE_VALUE"></a>[`CAP_NONFINITE_VALUE`](CAP_NONFINITE_VALUE.md) | error | A `NaN`/`Infinity` value reached the IR; the variant failed. | Check the story for a broken CSS value; otherwise use **Copy diagnostic** and send it to the support contact in Settings (usually a Holotype bug). |
| <a id="CAP_BOX_MODEL_FAILED"></a>[`CAP_BOX_MODEL_FAILED`](CAP_BOX_MODEL_FAILED.md) | info | The CDP box model was unavailable; the fast-path rect was used. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="CAP_ASSET_FETCH_FAILED"></a>[`CAP_ASSET_FETCH_FAILED`](CAP_ASSET_FETCH_FAILED.md) | warning | An image or asset could not be loaded; a grey placeholder fill was used. | Check the asset URL and auth; make sure the asset is served with the Storybook. |
| <a id="CAP_DOC_TOO_LARGE"></a>[`CAP_DOC_TOO_LARGE`](CAP_DOC_TOO_LARGE.md) | warning | Over 20 MB or 5,000 nodes; the largest subtrees were rasterized. | Split the story into smaller components. |
| <a id="CAP_NONDETERMINISTIC"></a>[`CAP_NONDETERMINISTIC`](CAP_NONDETERMINISTIC.md) | warning | Two captures of the same story differ (cache verification). | Remove randomness, dates or animations from the story (see the node paths in the report). |
| <a id="CAP_UNSTABLE_RENDER"></a>[`CAP_UNSTABLE_RENDER`](CAP_UNSTABLE_RENDER.md) | warning | The root kept changing size after settle. | Wait for data in loaders, or disable animations for capture. |
| <a id="CAP_VIEWPORT_GROWN"></a>[`CAP_VIEWPORT_GROWN`](CAP_VIEWPORT_GROWN.md) | info | The viewport was enlarged to fit the root. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="CAP_FIXED_IN_ROOT"></a>[`CAP_FIXED_IN_ROOT`](CAP_FIXED_IN_ROOT.md) | info | `position:fixed` content found; the viewport was not grown. | Nothing to do, or use `portal.frame: 'viewport'` for modals. |
| <a id="CAP_CHROMIUM_MISMATCH"></a>[`CAP_CHROMIUM_MISMATCH`](CAP_CHROMIUM_MISMATCH.md) | warning | `--chromium-path` differs from the pinned version; fidelity not guaranteed. | Use the pinned Chromium (`holotype install-browser`). |
| <a id="CAP_CLOSED_SHADOW_LATE"></a>[`CAP_CLOSED_SHADOW_LATE`](CAP_CLOSED_SHADOW_LATE.md) | warning | A closed shadow root was created before our hook; read through CDP instead. | Nothing to do unless content is missing; then use **Copy diagnostic** and send it to the support contact in Settings. |
| <a id="CAP_CSS_UNSUPPORTED"></a>[`CAP_CSS_UNSUPPORTED`](CAP_CSS_UNSUPPORTED.md) | warning | A CSS property has no Figma equivalent (`data.property`); it was ignored. | Check the affected layer; avoid the property for design-relevant styling. |
| <a id="CAP_TRANSFORM_SKEW"></a>[`CAP_TRANSFORM_SKEW`](CAP_TRANSFORM_SKEW.md) | info | A skew is expressed through `relativeTransform`. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="CAP_NATIVE_CONTROL_SYNTHESIZED"></a>[`CAP_NATIVE_CONTROL_SYNTHESIZED`](CAP_NATIVE_CONTROL_SYNTHESIZED.md) | info | A native control (input, checkbox, select) was rebuilt from frames and vectors. | Nothing to do. |

<a id="domain-layout"></a>

## Layout (`LAYOUT_`)

Auto-layout relaxations and read-back fallbacks in the plugin are `APPLY_LAYOUT_RELAXED` / `APPLY_LAYOUT_FALLBACK` (APPLY_ table).

| Code | Severity | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="LAYOUT_SIM_MISMATCH"></a>[`LAYOUT_SIM_MISMATCH`](LAYOUT_SIM_MISMATCH.md) | info | No auto-layout candidate matched the browser in simulation (`data.maxDelta`); the container is absolute. | Nothing to do; pixels match. For a resizable frame, simplify that container's CSS (flex or grid with uniform gaps). |
| <a id="LAYOUT_IRREGULAR_GAPS"></a>[`LAYOUT_IRREGULAR_GAPS`](LAYOUT_IRREGULAR_GAPS.md) | info | Margins could not be expressed as gaps, padding, wrappers or splits; the container is absolute. | Use `gap` instead of per-child margins, or set `mapper.allowSpacers`. |
| <a id="LAYOUT_ALIGN_SELF_WRAPPED"></a>[`LAYOUT_ALIGN_SELF_WRAPPED`](LAYOUT_ALIGN_SELF_WRAPPED.md) | info | Per-child `align-self` was expressed with a wrapper frame. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="LAYOUT_GROW_RATIO_FIXED"></a>[`LAYOUT_GROW_RATIO_FIXED`](LAYOUT_GROW_RATIO_FIXED.md) | info | Unequal `flex-grow` became FIXED sizes; pixels match, resizing differs. | Nothing to do, or use equal `flex: 1` for Figma-style fill. |
| <a id="LAYOUT_SPACE_AROUND_APPROX"></a>[`LAYOUT_SPACE_AROUND_APPROX`](LAYOUT_SPACE_AROUND_APPROX.md) | info | `space-around`/`space-evenly` became measured spacing (does not adapt on resize). | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="LAYOUT_WRAP_REVERSE_UNSUPPORTED"></a>[`LAYOUT_WRAP_REVERSE_UNSUPPORTED`](LAYOUT_WRAP_REVERSE_UNSUPPORTED.md) | info | `wrap-reverse` (or an unverifiable wrap) fell back to absolute. | Nothing to do, or use normal `wrap`. |
| <a id="LAYOUT_FLOAT_ABSOLUTE"></a>[`LAYOUT_FLOAT_ABSOLUTE`](LAYOUT_FLOAT_ABSOLUTE.md) | info | A float container became absolute. | Use flex or grid instead of floats for resizable frames. |
| <a id="LAYOUT_PERCENT_RESOLVED"></a>[`LAYOUT_PERCENT_RESOLVED`](LAYOUT_PERCENT_RESOLVED.md) | info | A `%` min/max size was resolved to px. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="LAYOUT_RTL_REVERSED"></a>[`LAYOUT_RTL_REVERSED`](LAYOUT_RTL_REVERSED.md) | info | An RTL row was emitted as reversed order. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="LAYOUT_BREAKPOINT_IN_PROBE"></a>[`LAYOUT_BREAKPOINT_IN_PROBE`](LAYOUT_BREAKPOINT_IN_PROBE.md) | info | A media/container query breakpoint limits the layout probe; crossing widths were skipped. | Nothing to do. Breakpoints become viewport variants ([04](../../internal/plan/04-variant-model.md)). |
| <a id="LAYOUT_GRID_MINMAX_FIXED"></a>[`LAYOUT_GRID_MINMAX_FIXED`](LAYOUT_GRID_MINMAX_FIXED.md) | info | A `minmax()` track became a fixed size. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="LAYOUT_GRID_AUTOFILL_FROZEN"></a>[`LAYOUT_GRID_AUTOFILL_FROZEN`](LAYOUT_GRID_AUTOFILL_FROZEN.md) | info | The `auto-fill`/`auto-fit` track count was frozen at the capture width. | Nothing to do; add viewports if the count should change. |
| <a id="LAYOUT_GRID_UNREPRESENTABLE"></a>[`LAYOUT_GRID_UNREPRESENTABLE`](LAYOUT_GRID_UNREPRESENTABLE.md) | warning | A grid feature (dense, areas, subgrid, overlap) has no Figma equivalent; stacks or absolute used. | Check the grid in Figma; simplify the grid if designers need to edit it. |
| <a id="LAYOUT_ZINDEX_HOIST"></a>[`LAYOUT_ZINDEX_HOIST`](LAYOUT_ZINDEX_HOIST.md) | warning | A layer painting above its ancestor's sibling was moved up the tree as absolute. | Nothing to do unless the layer order matters to designers; avoid z-index escapes. |
| <a id="LAYOUT_ZORDER_FLOW_CONFLICT"></a>[`LAYOUT_ZORDER_FLOW_CONFLICT`](LAYOUT_ZORDER_FLOW_CONFLICT.md) | warning | Paint order differs from flow order; the container is absolute. | Avoid z-index reordering of in-flow children. |
| <a id="LAYOUT_OVERFLOW_AXIS_APPROX"></a>[`LAYOUT_OVERFLOW_AXIS_APPROX`](LAYOUT_OVERFLOW_AXIS_APPROX.md) | warning | Overflow hidden on one axis only; Figma clips both. | Check for clipped content in Figma; set overflow on both axes. |

<a id="domain-text"></a>

## Text (`TEXT_`)

| Code | Severity | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="TEXT_LINE_MISMATCH"></a>[`TEXT_LINE_MISMATCH`](TEXT_LINE_MISMATCH.md) | warning | Figma wraps the text into a different number of lines than the browser, even after buffering. | Switch that text to locked-lines mode, or check that the font matches (see `FONT_*`). |
| <a id="TEXT_WIDTH_BUFFERED"></a>[`TEXT_WIDTH_BUFFERED`](TEXT_WIDTH_BUFFERED.md) | info | The text box was widened by a few px to match the browser's line count. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="TEXT_CASE_BAKED"></a>[`TEXT_CASE_BAKED`](TEXT_CASE_BAKED.md) | info | `text-transform` was baked into the characters (CSS and Figma casing differ here). | Nothing to do; edit the source text in code. |
| <a id="TEXT_SPLIT_MIDLINE"></a>[`TEXT_SPLIT_MIDLINE`](TEXT_SPLIT_MIDLINE.md) | info | Inline content was split into one text layer per line. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="TEXT_OVERLINE_OVERLAY"></a>[`TEXT_OVERLINE_OVERLAY`](TEXT_OVERLINE_OVERLAY.md) | info | An overline was drawn as a 1 px rectangle. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="TEXT_DECORATION_STYLE_APPROX"></a>[`TEXT_DECORATION_STYLE_APPROX`](TEXT_DECORATION_STYLE_APPROX.md) | info | A `double`/`dashed` underline became solid. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="TEXT_OVERLAY_LOCKED"></a>[`TEXT_OVERLAY_LOCKED`](TEXT_OVERLAY_LOCKED.md) | info | Text with overlays was switched to locked lines. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="TEXT_SHADOW_RANGE_APPROX"></a>[`TEXT_SHADOW_RANGE_APPROX`](TEXT_SHADOW_RANGE_APPROX.md) | warning | Text shadows differ across ranges; the dominant one was used. | Use one text shadow per text element. |
| <a id="TEXT_WORD_SPACING_DROPPED"></a>[`TEXT_WORD_SPACING_DROPPED`](TEXT_WORD_SPACING_DROPPED.md) | warning | `word-spacing` has no Figma equivalent and was dropped. | Use `letter-spacing`, or accept the difference. |
| <a id="TEXT_BASELINE_SHIFT_DROPPED"></a>[`TEXT_BASELINE_SHIFT_DROPPED`](TEXT_BASELINE_SHIFT_DROPPED.md) | warning | `vertical-align: super/sub` was dropped (Figma has no baseline shift). | Render super/subscript in its own element. |
| <a id="TEXT_OPENTYPE_UNSUPPORTED"></a>[`TEXT_OPENTYPE_UNSUPPORTED`](TEXT_OPENTYPE_UNSUPPORTED.md) | warning | OpenType features (e.g. `tnum`) cannot be written through the Plugin API. | Nothing to do; numeric widths use the text width buffer. |

<a id="domain-font"></a>

## Fonts (`FONT_`)

| Code | Severity | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="FONT_LOAD_FAILED"></a>[`FONT_LOAD_FAILED`](FONT_LOAD_FAILED.md) | warning | A web font failed to load in the browser (`data.src`). | Check the font URL and CORS; the capture used whatever font the browser fell back to. |
| <a id="FONT_FALLBACK_USED"></a>[`FONT_FALLBACK_USED`](FONT_FALLBACK_USED.md) | info | Some characters were drawn by a fallback font; the run was split by script. | Nothing to do, or load a font that covers those characters. |
| <a id="FONT_SYNTHETIC"></a>[`FONT_SYNTHETIC`](FONT_SYNTHETIC.md) | warning | The browser faked bold or italic; Figma will use the real style. | Load the real bold/italic face in Storybook so both match. |
| <a id="FONT_UNRESOLVED"></a>[`FONT_UNRESOLVED`](FONT_UNRESOLVED.md) | warning | The platform font could not be identified; the first family in the stack was used. | Name an explicit web font in `font-family`. |
| <a id="FONT_ICON_VECTORIZED"></a>[`FONT_ICON_VECTORIZED`](FONT_ICON_VECTORIZED.md) | info | Icon-font glyphs were converted to vector paths. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="FONT_MISSING"></a>[`FONT_MISSING`](FONT_MISSING.md) | warning | A font is not available in Figma; the fallback was applied. | Install the font for your Figma team, or map it in the **Fonts** screen; a re-sync restores the original. |
| <a id="FONT_SUBSTITUTED"></a>[`FONT_SUBSTITUTED`](FONT_SUBSTITUTED.md) | info | A font was mapped through your saved or chosen mapping. | Nothing to do; change the mapping in the **Fonts** screen. |
| <a id="FONT_AXIS_DROPPED"></a>[`FONT_AXIS_DROPPED`](FONT_AXIS_DROPPED.md) | info | A `font-variation-settings` axis the Figma family lacks was dropped. | Nothing to do. |

<a id="domain-paint"></a>

## Paint and effects (`PAINT_`)

| Code | Severity | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="PAINT_COLOR_READBACK"></a>[`PAINT_COLOR_READBACK`](PAINT_COLOR_READBACK.md) | info | A color was resolved through canvas read-back and clipped to sRGB. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="PAINT_COLOR_GAMUT_MAPPED"></a>[`PAINT_COLOR_GAMUT_MAPPED`](PAINT_COLOR_GAMUT_MAPPED.md) | info | An out-of-sRGB color was gamut-mapped. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="PAINT_GRADIENT_APPROX"></a>[`PAINT_GRADIENT_APPROX`](PAINT_GRADIENT_APPROX.md) | info | A gradient interpolation space (e.g. `in oklch`) was approximated with extra stops. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="PAINT_CONIC_APPROX"></a>[`PAINT_CONIC_APPROX`](PAINT_CONIC_APPROX.md) | info | A conic gradient's origin or direction is approximate (until S-03). | Check the gradient in Figma. |
| <a id="PAINT_REPEATING_CAPPED"></a>[`PAINT_REPEATING_CAPPED`](PAINT_REPEATING_CAPPED.md) | info | A repeating gradient was capped at 256 stops. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="PAINT_TABLE_BORDER_APPROX"></a>[`PAINT_TABLE_BORDER_APPROX`](PAINT_TABLE_BORDER_APPROX.md) | info | `border-collapse` was drawn by giving shared borders to one side. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="PAINT_DASH_APPROX"></a>[`PAINT_DASH_APPROX`](PAINT_DASH_APPROX.md) | info | Dashed borders use a Figma dash pattern; corners phase differently. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="PAINT_BORDER_DECOMPOSED"></a>[`PAINT_BORDER_DECOMPOSED`](PAINT_BORDER_DECOMPOSED.md) | info | Per-side border colors or styles became four vector layers. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="PAINT_BORDER_DOMINANT"></a>[`PAINT_BORDER_DOMINANT`](PAINT_BORDER_DOMINANT.md) | warning | Per-side borders on a rounded box, or with a dashed or dotted side, use one stroke in the dominant side's color and style. | Use one border color and style, or (rounded boxes) set `mapper.exactBorders: true` for exact paths. |
| <a id="PAINT_BORDER_STYLE_APPROX"></a>[`PAINT_BORDER_STYLE_APPROX`](PAINT_BORDER_STYLE_APPROX.md) | info | A `double`/`groove`/`ridge`/`inset`/`outset` border was approximated. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="PAINT_ELLIPTICAL_RADIUS_APPROX"></a>[`PAINT_ELLIPTICAL_RADIUS_APPROX`](PAINT_ELLIPTICAL_RADIUS_APPROX.md) | warning | Elliptical corner radii used the smaller radius. | Set `mapper.exactRadii: true` for an exact path. |
| <a id="PAINT_SPREAD_BACKING_RECT"></a>[`PAINT_SPREAD_BACKING_RECT`](PAINT_SPREAD_BACKING_RECT.md) | info | A shadow (with spread, or on a box without a visible fill) was moved to a backing rectangle. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="PAINT_RING_PROMOTED"></a>[`PAINT_RING_PROMOTED`](PAINT_RING_PROMOTED.md) | info | A ring shadow (e.g. Tailwind `ring-*`) became an outside stroke. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="PAINT_FILTER_RASTERIZED"></a>[`PAINT_FILTER_RASTERIZED`](PAINT_FILTER_RASTERIZED.md) | warning | A CSS filter other than blur/drop-shadow was rasterized. | Nothing to do, or apply the effect to an image asset instead. |
| <a id="PAINT_BLEND_UNSUPPORTED"></a>[`PAINT_BLEND_UNSUPPORTED`](PAINT_BLEND_UNSUPPORTED.md) | warning | A blend mode (e.g. `plus-lighter`) has no exact Figma match. | Check the layer in Figma; use a standard blend mode. |
| <a id="PAINT_SUBTREE_RASTERIZED"></a>[`PAINT_SUBTREE_RASTERIZED`](PAINT_SUBTREE_RASTERIZED.md) | warning | A subtree was captured as an image (`data.reason`); layers inside are not editable. | Check `data.reason`; avoid that CSS on design-relevant parts. |

<a id="domain-svg"></a>

## SVG (`SVG_`)

| Code | Severity | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="SVG_RASTERIZED"></a>[`SVG_RASTERIZED`](SVG_RASTERIZED.md) | warning | An SVG with a filter, mask or `foreignObject` was rasterized. | Set `capture.svg.rasterizeFilters: false` to try vectors, or simplify the SVG. |
| <a id="SVG_USE_UNRESOLVED"></a>[`SVG_USE_UNRESOLVED`](SVG_USE_UNRESOLVED.md) | warning | An SVG `<use>` target was not found. | Make sure the referenced symbol is in the page or the same shadow root. |
| <a id="SVG_ICON_FONT_RASTERIZED"></a>[`SVG_ICON_FONT_RASTERIZED`](SVG_ICON_FONT_RASTERIZED.md) | warning | An icon-font glyph could not be shaped and was captured as an image. | Make sure the icon font file is reachable, or use SVG icons. |
| <a id="SVG_ICON_EXTRACTED"></a>[`SVG_ICON_EXTRACTED`](SVG_ICON_EXTRACTED.md) | info | A repeated SVG was promoted to an icon component. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="SVG_IMPORT_FAILED"></a>[`SVG_IMPORT_FAILED`](SVG_IMPORT_FAILED.md) | warning | Figma could not import the SVG; a raster fallback was used. | Simplify the SVG (it is in the report), or use **Copy diagnostic** and send it to the support contact in Settings. |

<a id="domain-token"></a>

## Tokens (`TOKEN_`)

| Code | Severity | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="TOKEN_AUTHORED_UNAVAILABLE"></a>[`TOKEN_AUTHORED_UNAVAILABLE`](TOKEN_AUTHORED_UNAVAILABLE.md) | info | No matched styles for a node (e.g. inside a shadow root); its token bindings are degraded. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="TOKEN_UNUSED"></a>[`TOKEN_UNUSED`](TOKEN_UNUSED.md) | info | A discovered token is not used by any imported component (counted only). | Nothing to do; set `tokens.include: 'all'` to export it anyway. |
| <a id="TOKEN_FALLBACK_USED"></a>[`TOKEN_FALLBACK_USED`](TOKEN_FALLBACK_USED.md) | info | `var(--x, fallback)` used its fallback because `--x` is undefined; a literal was emitted. | Define the variable, or remove the dead `var()`. |
| <a id="TOKEN_EXPRESSION_UNBOUND"></a>[`TOKEN_EXPRESSION_UNBOUND`](TOKEN_EXPRESSION_UNBOUND.md) | info | A value comes from `calc()`, `color-mix()` or several vars; no variable can express it. | Add a token for the computed value if designers need it. |
| <a id="TOKEN_CLAMPED_UNBOUND"></a>[`TOKEN_CLAMPED_UNBOUND`](TOKEN_CLAMPED_UNBOUND.md) | info | A radius or size token was clamped by layout, so it was not bound. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="TOKEN_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH"></a>[`TOKEN_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH`](TOKEN_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH.md) | warning | CSS says `var(--x)` but the rendered value differs (opacity, filter, redeclaration); not bound. | Check the node named in the report for opacity, filters or a local redeclaration. |
| <a id="TOKEN_PRIVATE_CHAIN"></a>[`TOKEN_PRIVATE_CHAIN`](TOKEN_PRIVATE_CHAIN.md) | info | The value only resolves through component-private vars; not bound. | Point the private var at a global token. |
| <a id="TOKEN_ALIAS_CYCLE"></a>[`TOKEN_ALIAS_CYCLE`](TOKEN_ALIAS_CYCLE.md) | warning | Tokens alias each other in a cycle; broken with a literal. | Fix the cyclic definitions in your token source. |
| <a id="TOKEN_TYPE_CONFLICT"></a>[`TOKEN_TYPE_CONFLICT`](TOKEN_TYPE_CONFLICT.md) | warning | A token is used as incompatible types, or an alias changes type. | Give each use its own token of the right type. |
| <a id="TOKEN_NAME_COLLISION"></a>[`TOKEN_NAME_COLLISION`](TOKEN_NAME_COLLISION.md) | warning | Two CSS names map to the same Figma name; a numeric suffix was added. | Rename one of the tokens. |
| <a id="TOKEN_MODE_UNTOKENIZED_DIFF"></a>[`TOKEN_MODE_UNTOKENIZED_DIFF`](TOKEN_MODE_UNTOKENIZED_DIFF.md) | warning | A property changes between themes (or viewports) without a token, so modes can't express it. | Move the listed value into a token, or set `tokens.themeFallback: "variant-axis"`. |
| <a id="TOKEN_MODE_LIMIT"></a>[`TOKEN_MODE_LIMIT`](TOKEN_MODE_LIMIT.md) | warning | Your Figma plan's mode (or variable) limit was hit; the overflow policy was applied. | Choose an option in the plugin (first N as modes, or a Theme axis), reduce themes, or upgrade the plan. |
| <a id="TOKEN_EFFECT_MODE_DIFF"></a>[`TOKEN_EFFECT_MODE_DIFF`](TOKEN_EFFECT_MODE_DIFF.md) | info | A shadow differs per mode, but Figma effect styles have no modes. | Build the shadow from tokens so each part can be bound. |
| <a id="TOKEN_PADDING_BORDER_OFFSET"></a>[`TOKEN_PADDING_BORDER_OFFSET`](TOKEN_PADDING_BORDER_OFFSET.md) | info | Padding is not bound because Scene padding includes the border width (D-16). | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="TOKEN_RELATIVE_UNIT"></a>[`TOKEN_RELATIVE_UNIT`](TOKEN_RELATIVE_UNIT.md) | info | An `em`/`%` token has no stable px value; not bound. | Use a px or rem token for design-relevant sizes. |
| <a id="TOKEN_LIBRARY_VALUE_DRIFT"></a>[`TOKEN_LIBRARY_VALUE_DRIFT`](TOKEN_LIBRARY_VALUE_DRIFT.md) | warning | A library variable bound here has a different value than code; it was not changed. | Update the library file, or the code. |
| <a id="TOKEN_VALUE_AMBIGUOUS"></a>[`TOKEN_VALUE_AMBIGUOUS`](TOKEN_VALUE_AMBIGUOUS.md) | info | Value-equality matching found several candidate tokens; not bound. | Use `var()` in code for that property. |
| <a id="TOKEN_VALUE_MATCHED"></a>[`TOKEN_VALUE_MATCHED`](TOKEN_VALUE_MATCHED.md) | info | A binding was made by value equality only (opt-in, lower confidence). | Nothing to do; use `var()` in code for an exact binding. |
| <a id="TOKEN_SOURCE_CSS_MISMATCH"></a>[`TOKEN_SOURCE_CSS_MISMATCH`](TOKEN_SOURCE_CSS_MISMATCH.md) | warning | The tokens file and the CSS computed value differ. | Rebuild your tokens, or fix the CSS that overrides them. |
| <a id="TOKEN_BIND_FAILED"></a>[`TOKEN_BIND_FAILED`](TOKEN_BIND_FAILED.md) | warning | Figma refused a binding (field unsupported or variable scope mismatch); the literal was kept. | Widen the variable's scopes in Figma, or nothing to do. |
| <a id="TOKEN_ORPHANED"></a>[`TOKEN_ORPHANED`](TOKEN_ORPHANED.md) | info | A linked variable no longer exists in code. | Delete or deprecate the variable in Figma. |

<a id="domain-apply"></a>

## Apply (`APPLY_`)

| Code | Severity | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="APPLY_IR_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED"></a>[`APPLY_IR_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED`](APPLY_IR_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.md) | error | The bundle's (or a DCR's) IR major is not supported by this plugin or CLI; nothing is applied. | Update whichever side is older: the plugin, or the CLI (`npx @holotype/cli@latest`). |
| <a id="APPLY_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE"></a>[`APPLY_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE`](APPLY_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE.md) | error | The config requires an IR feature the plugin does not support (CLI), or a bundle lists a required feature the plugin does not know (plugin, [02 §4.3](../../internal/plan/02-architecture.md#protocol)). | Update the Figma plugin, or turn off the feature in config. |
| <a id="APPLY_BUNDLE_CORRUPT"></a>[`APPLY_BUNDLE_CORRUPT`](APPLY_BUNDLE_CORRUPT.md) | error | A bundle file's sha256 does not match `integrity`; the file was rejected. | Re-export the bundle, or re-send it from the CLI. |
| <a id="APPLY_BUNDLE_REJECTED"></a>[`APPLY_BUNDLE_REJECTED`](APPLY_BUNDLE_REJECTED.md) | error | The bundle breaks a safety limit (size, nodes, string length, zip ratio). | Split the run into smaller bundles; if you didn't create the file, don't import it. |
| <a id="APPLY_COMPONENT_FAILED"></a>[`APPLY_COMPONENT_FAILED`](APPLY_COMPONENT_FAILED.md) | error | The Figma API threw while applying a component; partial state left for resume. | Re-run the sync to resume. If it repeats, use **Copy diagnostic** and send it to the support contact in Settings. |
| <a id="APPLY_CANCELLED"></a>[`APPLY_CANCELLED`](APPLY_CANCELLED.md) | info | You cancelled; finished components are kept, the rest are marked partial. | Re-run the sync to finish. |
| <a id="APPLY_VARIANT_ADD_FAILED"></a>[`APPLY_VARIANT_ADD_FAILED`](APPLY_VARIANT_ADD_FAILED.md) | error | A variant could not be added to the existing set without breaking instance links. | Retry; if it fails again, Detach the old variant and re-sync (instances of that variant will need swapping). |
| <a id="APPLY_VARIANT_NAME_COLLISION"></a>[`APPLY_VARIANT_NAME_COLLISION`](APPLY_VARIANT_NAME_COLLISION.md) | error | Two variants resolve to the same `Prop=Value` name. | Give the colliding arg values distinct labels in config. |
| <a id="APPLY_SET_LARGE"></a>[`APPLY_SET_LARGE`](APPLY_SET_LARGE.md) | info | A set has more than 500 variants; Figma may get slow. | Lower the variant budget, or split the component. |
| <a id="APPLY_PROPERTY_BIND_FAILED"></a>[`APPLY_PROPERTY_BIND_FAILED`](APPLY_PROPERTY_BIND_FAILED.md) | warning | Figma rejected a component-property binding (type or node mismatch). | Nothing to do; the layer stays without that property. If it repeats, use **Copy diagnostic** and send it to the support contact in Settings. |
| <a id="APPLY_SLOT_UNSUPPORTED"></a>[`APPLY_SLOT_UNSUPPORTED`](APPLY_SLOT_UNSUPPORTED.md) | info | This Figma client has no slots; the slot became fixed content. | Update Figma, or nothing to do. |
| <a id="APPLY_INSTANCE_TARGET_MISSING"></a>[`APPLY_INSTANCE_TARGET_MISSING`](APPLY_INSTANCE_TARGET_MISSING.md) | warning | A nested component is not in the file; a frame was built instead. | Import the nested component, then re-sync. |
| <a id="APPLY_INSTANCE_MISMATCH"></a>[`APPLY_INSTANCE_MISMATCH`](APPLY_INSTANCE_MISMATCH.md) | warning | The created instance's geometry differs from the capture (read-back); a frame was built instead. | Nothing to do; the next run learns from it. Check the nested component's own story matches its usage. |
| <a id="APPLY_INSTANCE_OVERRIDE"></a>[`APPLY_INSTANCE_OVERRIDE`](APPLY_INSTANCE_OVERRIDE.md) | info | A literal override was applied on an instance. | Expose that text or toggle as a prop on the nested component. |
| <a id="APPLY_INSTANCE_CYCLE"></a>[`APPLY_INSTANCE_CYCLE`](APPLY_INSTANCE_CYCLE.md) | warning | Components nest each other in a cycle; broken with frames. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="APPLY_IMAGE_REJECTED"></a>[`APPLY_IMAGE_REJECTED`](APPLY_IMAGE_REJECTED.md) | warning | Figma refused an image (format or size). | Use **Copy diagnostic** (it includes the asset hash) and send it to the support contact in Settings. |
| <a id="APPLY_IMAGE_SKIPPED"></a>[`APPLY_IMAGE_SKIPPED`](APPLY_IMAGE_SKIPPED.md) | warning | An image was not applied (`use_figma` path or upload failure). | Re-run through the plugin to get the images. |
| <a id="APPLY_LAYOUT_RELAXED"></a>[`APPLY_LAYOUT_RELAXED`](APPLY_LAYOUT_RELAXED.md) | info | HUG/FILL sizing was relaxed to FIXED to pass read-back. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="APPLY_LAYOUT_FALLBACK"></a>[`APPLY_LAYOUT_FALLBACK`](APPLY_LAYOUT_FALLBACK.md) | warning | Auto layout failed read-back in Figma; the container became absolute. | Nothing to do; pixels match. If it repeats, use **Copy diagnostic** and send it to the support contact in Settings. |
| <a id="APPLY_MIXED_VALUE"></a>[`APPLY_MIXED_VALUE`](APPLY_MIXED_VALUE.md) | info | Figma returned `figma.mixed`; it was normalized. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="APPLY_NO_EDIT_ACCESS"></a>[`APPLY_NO_EDIT_ACCESS`](APPLY_NO_EDIT_ACCESS.md) | error | The file is view-only, open in Dev Mode, or not in a Design editor. | Holotype builds components. Open this file in Design mode with edit access. |

<a id="domain-sync"></a>

## Sync (`SYNC_`)

| Code | Severity | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="SYNC_CONFLICT"></a>[`SYNC_CONFLICT`](SYNC_CONFLICT.md) | warning | A designer edited a managed layer that code also changed; kept ("Keep mine"). | Resolve it in the diff: Keep mine, Take code, Fork or Lock. |
| <a id="SYNC_CONFLICT_OVERWRITTEN"></a>[`SYNC_CONFLICT_OVERWRITTEN`](SYNC_CONFLICT_OVERWRITTEN.md) | warning | You chose "Take code"; the designer's change was replaced (old values are in the report). | Nothing to do, or use Fork next time to keep a copy. |
| <a id="SYNC_KEEP_STALE"></a>[`SYNC_KEEP_STALE`](SYNC_KEEP_STALE.md) | warning | A layer you kept changed in code again. | Decide again in the diff. |
| <a id="SYNC_LOCKED_SKIPPED"></a>[`SYNC_LOCKED_SKIPPED`](SYNC_LOCKED_SKIPPED.md) | info | A locked subtree was skipped. | Nothing to do; unlock it to receive code changes. |
| <a id="SYNC_MANAGED_NODE_DELETED"></a>[`SYNC_MANAGED_NODE_DELETED`](SYNC_MANAGED_NODE_DELETED.md) | info | A designer deleted a managed layer; it was re-created (or kept deleted under `keep`). | Nothing to do; lock or unmanage the layer to keep it gone. |
| <a id="SYNC_NODE_REMOVED"></a>[`SYNC_NODE_REMOVED`](SYNC_NODE_REMOVED.md) | info | A managed layer no longer exists in code and was removed (impact: instance count). | Nothing to do, or set `sync.orphans: 'hide'`. |
| <a id="SYNC_TYPE_CHANGE_RECREATE"></a>[`SYNC_TYPE_CHANGE_RECREATE`](SYNC_TYPE_CHANGE_RECREATE.md) | warning | A layer changed type and was re-created; overrides restored/dropped are counted. | Check instances that overrode that layer. |
| <a id="SYNC_OVERRIDE_NOT_RESTORED"></a>[`SYNC_OVERRIDE_NOT_RESTORED`](SYNC_OVERRIDE_NOT_RESTORED.md) | warning | An instance override could not be restored after a structural change. | Re-apply the override on the instance listed in the report. |
| <a id="SYNC_OVERRIDES_AT_RISK"></a>[`SYNC_OVERRIDES_AT_RISK`](SYNC_OVERRIDES_AT_RISK.md) | warning | A change may drop overrides in files that use this library. | Review before publishing the library; tell consumers. |
| <a id="SYNC_BREAKING_CHANGE"></a>[`SYNC_BREAKING_CHANGE`](SYNC_BREAKING_CHANGE.md) | warning | The plan contains a breaking change; it needs acknowledgement. | Review it in the diff, then acknowledge. |
| <a id="SYNC_RENAME_DETECTED"></a>[`SYNC_RENAME_DETECTED`](SYNC_RENAME_DETECTED.md) | info | A component or variant was renamed in place; instances keep working. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="SYNC_RENAME_AMBIGUOUS"></a>[`SYNC_RENAME_AMBIGUOUS`](SYNC_RENAME_AMBIGUOUS.md) | info | A possible rename scored below the automatic threshold. | Confirm or reject the rename in the diff. |
| <a id="SYNC_DEPRECATED"></a>[`SYNC_DEPRECATED`](SYNC_DEPRECATED.md) | info | A component removed from code was moved to "Deprecated" (D-20). | Swap its instances, then delete it when unused. |
| <a id="SYNC_UNDEPRECATED"></a>[`SYNC_UNDEPRECATED`](SYNC_UNDEPRECATED.md) | info | A deprecated component is back in code and was restored. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="SYNC_DUPLICATE_SID"></a>[`SYNC_DUPLICATE_SID`](SYNC_DUPLICATE_SID.md) | warning | More than one set claims the same component id (e.g. a copy-paste). | Unmanage the copy when the plugin offers it. |
| <a id="SYNC_REGISTRY_REPAIRED"></a>[`SYNC_REGISTRY_REPAIRED`](SYNC_REGISTRY_REPAIRED.md) | info | The registry was missing or corrupt and was rebuilt from layer data. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="SYNC_LEASE_HELD"></a>[`SYNC_LEASE_HELD`](SYNC_LEASE_HELD.md) | warning | Another session is syncing this file. | Wait for it to finish, then retry. |
| <a id="SYNC_STALE_PLAN"></a>[`SYNC_STALE_PLAN`](SYNC_STALE_PLAN.md) | info | The file changed since planning; re-planned automatically. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="SYNC_UNMANAGED_AFFECTS_LAYOUT"></a>[`SYNC_UNMANAGED_AFFECTS_LAYOUT`](SYNC_UNMANAGED_AFFECTS_LAYOUT.md) | info | A layer a designer added caused a layout fallback. | Move the added layer outside the auto-layout frame, or nothing to do. |
| <a id="SYNC_LEGACY_NAMESPACE"></a>[`SYNC_LEGACY_NAMESPACE`](SYNC_LEGACY_NAMESPACE.md) | info | Reserved for a future plugin-data namespace migration; not emitted today. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="SYNC_BRANCH_RESIDUE"></a>[`SYNC_BRANCH_RESIDUE`](SYNC_BRANCH_RESIDUE.md) | warning | The library file carries `branch:meta`/`base:*` (a branch was merged into it). | This library contains leftovers of a merged branch. Review the cleanup list, then Re-sync. |

<a id="domain-net"></a>

## Network (`NET_`)

| Code | Severity | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="NET_SERVER_UNREACHABLE"></a>[`NET_SERVER_UNREACHABLE`](NET_SERVER_UNREACHABLE.md) | warning | No Holotype server answered on the local ports. | Run `holotype serve`, or import a bundle file instead. |
| <a id="NET_LNA_BLOCKED"></a>[`NET_LNA_BLOCKED`](NET_LNA_BLOCKED.md) | error | The browser blocked local network access from Figma. | Use the Figma desktop app, allow "Apps on device" for figma.com, or import a file. |
| <a id="NET_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED"></a>[`NET_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED`](NET_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED.md) | error | The plugin manifest does not allow this address (a Holotype bug). | Import a file meanwhile; use **Copy diagnostic** and send it to the support contact in Settings. |
| <a id="NET_PAIRING_FAILED"></a>[`NET_PAIRING_FAILED`](NET_PAIRING_FAILED.md) | error | The pairing code was wrong or expired. | Copy a fresh code from the `holotype serve` output. |
| <a id="NET_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH"></a>[`NET_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH`](NET_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH.md) | error | The plugin and CLI share no protocol version. | Update whichever side the message names (CLI or plugin). |
| <a id="NET_PORT_IN_USE"></a>[`NET_PORT_IN_USE`](NET_PORT_IN_USE.md) | error | The CLI could not bind any of ports 47321–47323. | Stop the other `holotype serve` (or the app using the port) and retry. |
| <a id="NET_HOST_REJECTED"></a>[`NET_HOST_REJECTED`](NET_HOST_REJECTED.md) | error | The local server refused a request with a foreign Host header (DNS-rebinding guard); answers 421. | Nothing to do if you didn't expect it: a web page tried to reach your local server. Use `127.0.0.1` or `localhost`. |
| <a id="NET_FIGMA_TOKEN_MISSING"></a>[`NET_FIGMA_TOKEN_MISSING`](NET_FIGMA_TOKEN_MISSING.md) | error | No Figma token for REST reads. | Holotype needs a read-only Figma token. Create one in Figma ▸ Settings ▸ Security ▸ Personal access tokens (scope: File content, read), then run `holotype login --figma`. |
| <a id="NET_FIGMA_TOKEN_EXPIRING"></a>[`NET_FIGMA_TOKEN_EXPIRING`](NET_FIGMA_TOKEN_EXPIRING.md) | warning | The stored token expires within 14 days (personal access tokens last at most 90 days). | Create a new token, or use a plan access token in CI. |

<a id="domain-sec"></a>

## Security (`SEC_`)

| Code | Severity | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="SEC_SECRET_IN_CONFIG"></a>[`SEC_SECRET_IN_CONFIG`](SEC_SECRET_IN_CONFIG.md) | error | The config file contains a token- or password-like literal; the run stops. | Move the secret to an env variable (`HOLOTYPE_SB_TOKEN`) or `holotype login`, and rotate it if the file was shared. |
| <a id="SEC_SECRET_ON_ARGV"></a>[`SEC_SECRET_ON_ARGV`](SEC_SECRET_ON_ARGV.md) | warning | A secret was passed with `--header`/`--basic-auth`, where process lists and shell history can show it. | Use an env variable or `holotype login` instead. |
| <a id="SEC_SECRET_REDACTED"></a>[`SEC_SECRET_REDACTED`](SEC_SECRET_REDACTED.md) | info | Input and password values were blanked by the redaction setting. | Nothing to do; see `redaction.inputs`. |
| <a id="SEC_PUBLIC_REGISTRY"></a>[`SEC_PUBLIC_REGISTRY`](SEC_PUBLIC_REGISTRY.md) | warning | `holotype publish` targets a public registry while the Storybook is private. | Publish to a private registry, unless the UI is meant to be public. |
| <a id="SEC_EGRESS_BLOCKED"></a>[`SEC_EGRESS_BLOCKED`](SEC_EGRESS_BLOCKED.md) | warning | The hosted worker blocked a request to a private address. | Host the assets on a public URL, or run Holotype locally. |
| <a id="SEC_LICENSE_DENIED"></a>[`SEC_LICENSE_DENIED`](SEC_LICENSE_DENIED.md) | error | A dependency's license is not on the allow-list; the build fails. | Replace the dependency, or get the license reviewed. |

<a id="domain-dcr"></a>

## Design change requests (`DCR_`)

Reused from other domains: `SYNC_DUPLICATE_SID`, `SYNC_LOCKED_SKIPPED`, `SYNC_MANAGED_NODE_DELETED`, `SYNC_LEASE_HELD`, `NET_SERVER_UNREACHABLE`, `SEC_SECRET_IN_CONFIG`, `SEC_SECRET_ON_ARGV`, `APPLY_IR_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED`.

| Code | Severity | What happened | What to do |
|---|---|---|---|
| <a id="DCR_NOT_BRANCH_FILE"></a>[`DCR_NOT_BRANCH_FILE`](DCR_NOT_BRANCH_FILE.md) | error | This Figma file has no branch metadata (it is a library file). | Run `holotype branch link` on the branch file. |
| <a id="DCR_GIT_BRANCH_MISMATCH"></a>[`DCR_GIT_BRANCH_MISMATCH`](DCR_GIT_BRANCH_MISMATCH.md) | error | The request's branch differs from the CLI's current git branch. | Run `git switch <branch>`, then retry. Or download the request. |
| <a id="DCR_BRANCH_FILE_COPIED"></a>[`DCR_BRANCH_FILE_COPIED`](DCR_BRANCH_FILE_COPIED.md) | warning | `figma.fileKey`/`fileId` differs from `branch:meta` (a copy of a branch file). | "This is a copy of branch file &lt;branch>." Choose **Link this copy** or **Treat as library**. |
| <a id="DCR_CONFIG_DRIFT"></a>[`DCR_CONFIG_DRIFT`](DCR_CONFIG_DRIFT.md) | warning | The local `dcr` config hash differs from `branch:meta.dcrConfig`. | This branch file uses older request settings. Run `holotype branch refresh`. |
| <a id="DCR_NO_SUBMITTED_REQUEST"></a>[`DCR_NO_SUBMITTED_REQUEST`](DCR_NO_SUBMITTED_REQUEST.md) | error | `holotype dcr --pull` found no `branch:meta.lastDcr`. | Nothing was submitted from this file yet. Ask the designer to press **Submit**. |
| <a id="DCR_BASELINE_MISSING"></a>[`DCR_BASELINE_MISSING`](DCR_BASELINE_MISSING.md) | error | No embedded snapshot and no CLI-cache baseline for a variant. | Run `holotype branch refresh`. |
| <a id="DCR_BASELINE_EXTERNAL"></a>[`DCR_BASELINE_EXTERNAL`](DCR_BASELINE_EXTERNAL.md) | warning | The snapshot was over budget and is only in the CLI cache; REST-only extraction is incomplete. | Run `dcr` on the machine that generated the branch, or raise the snapshot budget. |
| <a id="DCR_BASELINE_SHIFTED"></a>[`DCR_BASELINE_SHIFTED`](DCR_BASELINE_SHIFTED.md) | warning | Code changed a layer the designer also edited (after refresh). | Review both values in the item before handing it to the agent. |
| <a id="DCR_BASELINE_DIRTY"></a>[`DCR_BASELINE_DIRTY`](DCR_BASELINE_DIRTY.md) | info | The baseline was generated from uncommitted code. | Commit before `holotype branch start` next time. |
| <a id="DCR_SNAPSHOT_PARITY"></a>[`DCR_SNAPSHOT_PARITY`](DCR_SNAPSHOT_PARITY.md) | warning | Plugin and REST snapshots differ for the same version. | Extract from the plugin (preferred); use **Copy diagnostic** and send it to the support contact in Settings. |
| <a id="DCR_SCOPE_EMPTY"></a>[`DCR_SCOPE_EMPTY`](DCR_SCOPE_EMPTY.md) | info | Nothing is in scope (e.g. no frame marked Ready for dev). | Mark frames Ready for dev, or change the scope. |
| <a id="DCR_NODE_AMBIGUOUS"></a>[`DCR_NODE_AMBIGUOUS`](DCR_NODE_AMBIGUOUS.md) | info | Duplicated layer ids were resolved by canonical order. | Nothing to do. |
| <a id="DCR_REMOTE_COMPONENT_UNRESOLVED"></a>[`DCR_REMOTE_COMPONENT_UNRESOLVED`](DCR_REMOTE_COMPONENT_UNRESOLVED.md) | warning | A library instance's key is not in the registry `keys.json`. | Export keys from the library file, then extract again. |
| <a id="DCR_PROPERTY_UNMAPPED"></a>[`DCR_PROPERTY_UNMAPPED`](DCR_PROPERTY_UNMAPPED.md) | warning | An instance property value has no arg mapping; kept as an open question. | Answer the question in the DCR. |
| <a id="DCR_FIELD_UNMAPPABLE"></a>[`DCR_FIELD_UNMAPPABLE`](DCR_FIELD_UNMAPPABLE.md) | warning | A Figma field has no CSS equivalent (e.g. corner smoothing). | Answer the open question, or describe the intent in an annotation. |
| <a id="DCR_VALUE_UNTOKENIZED"></a>[`DCR_VALUE_UNTOKENIZED`](DCR_VALUE_UNTOKENIZED.md) | warning | A raw value is used; matching tokens are listed. | Bind the variable in Figma, or pick a token in the question. |
| <a id="DCR_VALUE_NO_TOKEN"></a>[`DCR_VALUE_NO_TOKEN`](DCR_VALUE_NO_TOKEN.md) | warning | A raw value matches no token. | Answer the question: new token or literal. |
| <a id="DCR_NEAREST_COMPONENT"></a>[`DCR_NEAREST_COMPONENT`](DCR_NEAREST_COMPONENT.md) | info | A new component looks like an existing one (similarity ≥ 0.6). | Answer the question: extend the existing one or create a new one. |
| <a id="DCR_PROVENANCE_MISSING"></a>[`DCR_PROVENANCE_MISSING`](DCR_PROVENANCE_MISSING.md) | warning | No code location (no CDP or source map, or plugin-only extraction); not raised for a browser default or initial value (`FieldOrigin.default`). | Capture from the dev server through the CLI. |
| <a id="DCR_PROVENANCE_MINIFIED"></a>[`DCR_PROVENANCE_MINIFIED`](DCR_PROVENANCE_MINIFIED.md) | info | Code locations point at built CSS (static build). | Use the dev server for branch mode. |
| <a id="DCR_PROVENANCE_NO_SOURCEMAP"></a>[`DCR_PROVENANCE_NO_SOURCEMAP`](DCR_PROVENANCE_NO_SOURCEMAP.md) | warning | A dev-server stylesheet has no source map (`sourceMapURL`). With a `data-vite-dev-id` the file is known and its served line numbers are kept (`data.approximate: true`: the line may be off); without one only the selector is known (`data.approximate: false`). | Enable `css.devSourcemap` (Holotype does this automatically in branch mode); check a custom Vite config. |
| <a id="DCR_PROVENANCE_STALE"></a>[`DCR_PROVENANCE_STALE`](DCR_PROVENANCE_STALE.md) | warning | A code location could not be remapped from `baseCommit` to HEAD. | Code moved since this file was built. Run `holotype branch refresh`. |
| <a id="DCR_UNKNOWN_CHANGE"></a>[`DCR_UNKNOWN_CHANGE`](DCR_UNKNOWN_CHANGE.md) | warning | A change could not be classified; listed raw. | Add an annotation that says what you meant. |
| <a id="DCR_TOO_LARGE"></a>[`DCR_TOO_LARGE`](DCR_TOO_LARGE.md) | warning | More than 200 items. | Split by component with `--split`. |
| <a id="DCR_NOTE_SUSPICIOUS"></a>[`DCR_NOTE_SUSPICIOUS`](DCR_NOTE_SUSPICIOUS.md) | info | Designer text looks like instructions to the AI (still fenced as data). | Nothing to do; reword the note if it wasn't meant that way. |
| <a id="DCR_VERIFY_PARTIAL"></a>[`DCR_VERIFY_PARTIAL`](DCR_VERIFY_PARTIAL.md) | warning | Some items are only partly implemented; a follow-up DCR was written. | Hand the follow-up DCR to the agent and verify again. |
| <a id="DCR_VERIFY_PENDING"></a>[`DCR_VERIFY_PENDING`](DCR_VERIFY_PENDING.md) | error | Items have no implementation. | Implement them (or have the agent do it), then run `holotype verify` again. |
| <a id="DCR_VERIFY_NO_STORY"></a>[`DCR_VERIFY_NO_STORY`](DCR_VERIFY_NO_STORY.md) | error | A new item has no story that `implements` it. | Add the story. |
| <a id="DCR_VERIFY_NOT_VERIFIABLE"></a>[`DCR_VERIFY_NOT_VERIFIABLE`](DCR_VERIFY_NOT_VERIFIABLE.md) | info | The item can't be verified automatically (e.g. a screen without a story). | Check it by hand in review. |
| <a id="DCR_VERIFY_REGRESSED"></a>[`DCR_VERIFY_REGRESSED`](DCR_VERIFY_REGRESSED.md) | warning | A non-target variant of a touched component no longer matches its baseline. | Scope the change to the listed variants. |
| <a id="DCR_SCREEN_NAME_UNPARSED"></a>[`DCR_SCREEN_NAME_UNPARSED`](DCR_SCREEN_NAME_UNPARSED.md) | info | A screen appears at several widths, but its frame names have no breakpoint or state. | Rename frames to `Screen / Breakpoint / State`, or group them in a Section. |
| <a id="DCR_SCREEN_VARIANT_DUPLICATE"></a>[`DCR_SCREEN_VARIANT_DUPLICATE`](DCR_SCREEN_VARIANT_DUPLICATE.md) | warning | Two frames map to the same screen, breakpoint and state; the later one became `#2`. | Rename one of the frames. |
| <a id="DCR_SCREEN_STATE_MISSING"></a>[`DCR_SCREEN_STATE_MISSING`](DCR_SCREEN_STATE_MISSING.md) | info | A state listed in `dcr.screens.expectStates` isn't designed. | Design it, or answer the question to let the agent decide. |
| <a id="DCR_INTERACTION_UNSUPPORTED"></a>[`DCR_INTERACTION_UNSUPPORTED`](DCR_INTERACTION_UNSUPPORTED.md) | info | A prototype action has no v1 mapping (set variable, conditional…); kept raw. | Describe the behaviour in an annotation. |
| <a id="DCR_INTERACTION_TARGET_OUT_OF_SCOPE"></a>[`DCR_INTERACTION_TARGET_OUT_OF_SCOPE`](DCR_INTERACTION_TARGET_OUT_OF_SCOPE.md) | info | An interaction's destination is not in the DCR scope. | Add the destination to the scope, or accept a placeholder route. |
| <a id="DCR_CONTENT_PLACEHOLDER"></a>[`DCR_CONTENT_PLACEHOLDER`](DCR_CONTENT_PLACEHOLDER.md) | info | A screen still holds placeholder text (lorem, `{{…}}`, component default). | Replace it with final copy, or mark it as dynamic data. |
| <a id="DCR_A11Y_UNKNOWN_ROLE"></a>[`DCR_A11Y_UNKNOWN_ROLE`](DCR_A11Y_UNKNOWN_ROLE.md) | info | An annotated role is not a WAI-ARIA 1.2 role. | Fix the role in the annotation. |
| <a id="DCR_A11Y_FOCUS_ORDER_GAP"></a>[`DCR_A11Y_FOCUS_ORDER_GAP`](DCR_A11Y_FOCUS_ORDER_GAP.md) | info | The focus order has duplicates or gaps in a screen variant. | Fix the focus-order annotations. |
| <a id="DCR_INSTANCE_OUTDATED"></a>[`DCR_INSTANCE_OUTDATED`](DCR_INSTANCE_OUTDATED.md) | info | Instances of an older component version; the current one is used. | Optionally update the instances in Figma. |
| <a id="DCR_INSTANCE_DEPRECATED"></a>[`DCR_INSTANCE_DEPRECATED`](DCR_INSTANCE_DEPRECATED.md) | warning | Instances of a deprecated component; its replacement is used. | Optionally swap the instances in Figma. |
| <a id="DCR_DEPRECATED_NO_REPLACEMENT"></a>[`DCR_DEPRECATED_NO_REPLACEMENT`](DCR_DEPRECATED_NO_REPLACEMENT.md) | warning | A deprecated component has no replacement on record. | Add `parameters.holotype.replacedBy` (or a `dcr.deprecations` entry), or answer the question. |
| <a id="DCR_IMPORT_UNRESOLVED"></a>[`DCR_IMPORT_UNRESOLVED`](DCR_IMPORT_UNRESOLVED.md) | warning | No import path for a component used in a screen. | Set `dcr.targets.components.package`, or export the component. |
| <a id="DCR_NOT_APPROVED"></a>[`DCR_NOT_APPROVED`](DCR_NOT_APPROVED.md) | error | `dcr.requireApproval` is on and this DCR is not approved. | Ask a reviewer to approve it in the plugin preview. |
| <a id="DCR_APPROVAL_STALE"></a>[`DCR_APPROVAL_STALE`](DCR_APPROVAL_STALE.md) | warning | The approval was for an earlier version; the DCR changed since. | Ask the reviewer to approve again. |
